judgment_text:
ORDER

The petitioners seek payment of enhanced compensation at Rs 50,000 per cent with all other benefits.

2. The petitioners' lands were acquired for Chennai City Water Course Scheme. In respect of lands covered by the same Notification, compensation was fixed by the Supreme Court at Rs 50,000 per cent in matters pertaining to other land owners. Relying thereon, the present writ petition has been filed.

3. The learned counsel for the petitioners also relies on an order dated 6-10-2025 of this Court in W.P. No. 36795 of 2025. He submits that the petitioners are entitled to a similar benefit.

4. Mr A. Selvendran, learned Special Government Pleader, accepts notice for all the respondents. He submits that the petitioners have approached this Court belatedly and not within the time limit specified in Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

5. As contended by learned counsel for the petitioners, the petitioners are placed in substantially similar position as the petitioner in W.P. No. 36795 of 2025. Therefore, the petitioners are entitled to parity of treatment. Accordingly, this writ petition is disposed of by directing the respondents to consider the petitioners' request by taking note of the judgment of the Supreme Court in Civil Appeal Nos. 9526 to 9630 of 2018, 9531 & 9532 of 2018 and the recent order of this Court in W.P. No. 36795 of 2025. A decision shall be taken within four weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order. There shall be no order as to costs.
